messages:
noah: Quick catch  our /generate examples use `max_tokens` in some places and `max_new_tokens` in others. OpenAPI shows max_tokens, SDK snippets use max_new_tokens. Confusing.

tara: Which is the canonical param on the REST surface? Backend accepts max_new_tokens only, and we translate max_tokens in some SDK helpers for backwards compat. We should standardize docs to max_new_tokens and note the legacy alias.

kevin: Also noticed the example response in the API ref omits the `finish_reason` field (we only show text). Streaming examples show it, non-streaming don't. OpenAPI schema for responses has `choices[].finish_reason` optional but our samples forget it. Customers expect it for stop logic.

ryan: Agreed. Small PR: 1) rename all API examples to `max_new_tokens`, 2) update SDK snippets with a comment about the alias, 3) fix the example response payload to include `finish_reason` and a token usage block. I'll add a short migration note.

noah: Can you also double-check examples in the Java & Go SDKs? Last time we missed a JS snippet in the sidebar.

kevin: Working on a concrete example we can drop into the ref. Current (incorrect) generate response sample:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_123",
  "object": "generation",
  "choices": [
    { "text": "Hello world" }
  ]
}
```
Suggested corrected sample to include in API ref and OpenAPI examples:
```json
{
  "id": "gen_123",
  "object": "generation",
  "choices": [
    { "text": "Hello world", "finish_reason": "stop" }
  ],
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 5, "completion_tokens": 2, "total_tokens": 7 }
}
```

ryan: Nice. For the param change, add a single-sentence migration note: "If your client still sends `max_tokens`, it will be accepted for now but will be deprecated; please use `max_new_tokens` going forward." Put that in the migration guide section + changelog entry.

tara: I'll open the docs PR and include a small test that fails the OpenAPI example generation if examples don't match the schema. Branch: `docs/generate-param-response-sample-fix`.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/410  title: standardize-max-new-tokens-and-response-samples. CI: docs build queued.

noah: Ping me once PR is ready for review. I'll check Java/Go snippets and the API ref anchors.

kevin: PR includes updated JS/TS/py/go examples and updated OpenAPI YAML. Also added a note in the migration guide. CC @noah.

ryan: Left one nit on wording ("deprecated soon" -> "deprecated in a future release").

kevin: Fixed wording, re-pushed.

docs-bot: PR merged by tara into main  deployed to staging docs.

noah: Great. I'll follow up with a short support FAQ blurb explaining `finish_reason` and common stop token issues.
